item.title: [+3] Rupee slips below to 95.18 against dollar on elevated oil prices
item.description:
Signal: a weaker rupee. 22 reports from The New Indian Express, TradingView, Deccan Chronicle and 17 more. Related: “Rupee falls as importer demand and high crude prices weigh”. Turn: earlier readings (23 Oct) pointed the other way.

IT services: strong tailwind (+3) — IT exporters earn more in rupees

Why it matters: A weaker rupee raises the cost of oil and other imports and imported inflation, but lifts IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −3, Inflation outlook −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] US dollar steadies ahead of Fed decision as oil prices and Treasury yields retreat
item.description:
Signal: a stronger dollar. 2 reports from Zee Business, Economies.com. Related: “us markets rally crude 110 dollar index gold silver updates”. Mixed: 1 report points the other way. Turn: earlier readings (23 Oct) pointed the other way.

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Dollar earnings worth more

Why it matters: A stronger dollar pressures the rupee and draws foreign money out of emerging markets.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
